gaps.why: View colors code with the highlighter; the visual editor shows code in one color.
A paragraph with a footnote reference, a reference link or inline math is kept as source in Edit.
Blocks the visual editor cannot rewrite exactly (front matter, alerts, math, diagrams, HTML, footnotes) show their source instead of View's drawing.
View puts a # link before each heading.
View marks a file reference in plain text as a code reference chip.
View draws inline code that names a file as a code reference chip.
View underlines a link to a missing file.
